user.title: InBody account
user.description: Use the same login as the InBody app. The login ID is the phone number used at registration (digits only, no country code or +). This integration uses the unofficial InBody mobile API.

data_description.import_history: Fetches your full InBody history once, in the background, and adds it to the long-term statistics of the sensors. You can also run it later with the ha_inbody.import_history action.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate InBody
reauth_confirm.description: The InBody login failed. Enter your password again.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check the phone number and password.
error.unsupported_country: InBody does not publish an API host for this country code.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This InBody account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That login belongs to a different InBody account.

import_history.title: Import history
import_history.description: Fetches every scan stored in your InBody account and adds it to the long-term statistics of the sensors. It can take a little while and is safe to run more than once. Select Submit to start.

error.import_failed: The import failed. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.import_done: Done. Found {scans} scans and wrote {points} hourly statistics points. They appear in statistics graphs.
abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Fix its connection first (see the notifications), then try again.
abort.unsupported_version: This Home Assistant version does not support the history import.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Fetches every scan stored in your InBody account and writes it to the long-term statistics of the InBody sensors, so past measurements appear in statistics graphs. Safe to run more than once.

config_entry_id.name: InBody account
config_entry_id.description: Which InBody account to import. Leave empty to import all configured accounts.
